description: Use when asked about the cannabis market or industry figures. Facts from cannabis industry news in our own words, each with its number, the data source the article names (or "no source named") and a link to the publisher. Market context, not medical evidence. Newest article first; replaced figures are left out unless asked for. Example arguments: {"limit":5}.

include_replaced.description: True to include figures a newer signal replaced (history).

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 50.

region.description: Only signals of this region, for example "de" or "eu".

since.description: A day, YYYY-MM-DD: only signals from articles on or after it.

name: market_signals
title: Market signals
